_comment: Default configuration. Everything here can be overridden from the extension's Options page (or by importing a JSON file with the same shape). Never put passwords or secrets in this file.

checklist.label: Close checklist
checklist._comment: Standard SAP API (API_INSPECTIONLOT_SRV), no custom ABAP - EAM/QM inspection lots. This entity set has no Usage Decision field, so 'join' fetches A_InspLotUsageDecision separately and merges it in by InspectionLot (see sapClient.js's mergeJoinedRows). Field/filter names here are the best-documented ones found (SAP Help Portal + API Business Hub), but weren't checked against this system's own $metadata - if a section shows 'Could not load', that's the first thing to check ($GET .../API_INSPECTIONLOT_SRV/$metadata). No company code exists on an inspection lot; this scopes by sap.plant instead (see Settings). There's no owner field either (nameFromId/statusMeansDoneWhenNonBlank below make up for the fields this API doesn't have - see processing.js's analyzeChecklist).

query.$filter: CompanyCode eq '{companyCode}' and FiscalYear eq '{fiscalYear}' and FiscalPeriod eq '{period}'

grir.label: Open GR/IR items
grir._comment: Standard SAP API (API_OPLACCTGDOCITEMCUBE_SRV), no custom ABAP - filtered to the GR/IR clearing G/L account (sap.grirAccount) and uncleared lines. This entity is individual accounting document line items, not a pre-aggregated PO-item balance the way the old CDS view was, so groupByPoItem tells the extension to sum GR vs IR lines per PO item client-side first (see processing.js's aggregateGrirLineItems) - a goods receipt posts credit (H) to this account, an invoice receipt posts debit (S), which is how the two are told apart. Field names and the account number were verified against this system's real $metadata and data, not just documentation - see abap/README.md.

query.$filter: CompanyCode eq '{companyCode}' and GLAccount eq '{grirAccount}' and IsCleared eq false
CompanyCode eq '{companyCode}' and FiscalYear eq '{fiscalYear}' and FiscalPeriod eq '{period}'
